spanish: Y este a ustedes el impuro en el animal el reptante sobre la tierra: la comadreja y el ratón y la tortuga a su especie,

findings.issue: בַּשֶּׁרֶץ (H8318) is the swarming/creeping creature, cognate with the following participle; "el animal" adds a generic animal and drops that noun.
צָב (H6632) is an open land-swarmer lemma (lizard or tortoise); "la tortuga" fixes it as tortoise.
Qal participle הַשֹּׁרֵץ means swarm/teem/creep; "el reptante" keeps only crawling and does not repeat the noun's root.
חֹלֶד (H2467) is commonly weasel but also taken as mole; "la comadreja" selects weasel.

notes: Y este, a ustedes, el impuro, sobre la tierra, el ratón, and a su especie match the tokens; the verbless clause correctly has no unmarked copula.
